top_stories.title: Critical Keycloak Password Reset Flaw Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Take Over Any Account
top_stories.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-18963, CVSS 9.1) in Keycloak, the open-source identity and access management server, allows unauthenticated remote attackers to take over any user account by forcing a password reset. Red Hat and the Keycloak project have released patches to address the flaw.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Patches Severe Entra ID Flaw (CVSS 10.0) Allowing Remote Code Execution
top_stories.summary: Microsoft patched a critical vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID with a CVSS score of 10.0 that could allow remote code execution. Microsoft initially marked the flaw as exploited before correcting that status to "No" after media inquiry, clarifying the vulnerability had not been exploited in the wild.

top_stories.title: ShinyHunters taunts ReliaQuest after its own employee falls for social engineering attack
top_stories.summary: A ReliaQuest employee fell for a social engineering attack, providing attackers with a password and temporary access to the company's identity system. The extortion group ShinyHunters subsequently posted screenshots on its leak site claiming broader access to the cybersecurity firm's systems.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Fixes 'Perfect 10' Exploit That Could Have Let Hackers Run Code Remotely
top_stories.summary: Microsoft patched a critical severity vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID that received a perfect 10 CVE score and could have allowed remote code execution. Microsoft resolved the flaw before publicly disclosing the CVE and reported no evidence of exploitation in the wild.

top_stories.title: N-able Bug Exposes Password Vault Master Keys
top_stories.summary: A vulnerability in N-able's Passportal password manager exposed master keys to the password vault. The flaw affects MSPs and SMBs using the cloud-based product, and concerns remain about the security of cloud-hosted password vault architectures even after patching.

news.title: From Fake Workers to Account Recovery: The Growing Identity Verification Risk
news.summary: Attackers are shifting focus from login-based attacks to targeting identity establishment and account recovery processes to gain legitimate access. Specops outlines how organizations can strengthen identity verification practices to counter threats such as fake worker schemes and social engineering.

news.title: WhatsApp adds stronger two-step verification, multiple passkeys
news.summary: WhatsApp is rolling out new account security features including support for multiple passkeys and enhanced two-step verification. The update expands passkey functionality and strengthens authentication options for the messaging platform's users.

news.title: TruffleHog AWS Analyze reduces remediation time on leaked AWS credentials
news.summary: Truffle Security launched TruffleHog AWS Analyze, a new feature for TruffleHog Enterprise that enriches discovered AWS credentials with permissions and access level context. The tool extends existing credential detection across 800+ secret types by adding identity and access analysis for AWS, following prior support for SaaS platforms and Google Cloud.

news.title: WhatsApp Adds Multiple Passkeys for Phishing-Resistant Sign-Ins Across iOS and Android
news.summary: Meta has announced support for multiple passkeys on a single WhatsApp account, enabling phishing-resistant sign-ins across both iOS and Android devices. The feature expands on passkey support first introduced for Android in October 2023, with Meta reporting over 1 billion users already using passkeys to log into WhatsApp.

news.title: Mirage2FA Surge Hits 4,500 US and EU Companies, Abusing Microsoft 365 Login Flows
news.summary: A phishing-as-a-service toolkit called Mirage2FA has targeted 4,500 US and EU companies between 2024 and 2026 by abusing Microsoft 365 login flows to bypass two-factor authentication. Research from ANY.RUN found that 48% of targeted email addresses were potentially compromised, with the majority of affected organizations based in the US.

news.title: Attackers Target miniOrange SAML Flaws That Can Grant WordPress Admin Access
news.summary: Attackers are actively exploiting two critical unauthenticated authentication bypass vulnerabilities (including CVE-2026-61979, CVSS 8.1) in the miniOrange SAML 2.0 Single Sign On WordPress plugin. The flaws allow unauthenticated attackers to sign in as any WordPress user, including administrators, bypassing SAML-based authentication controls entirely.

news.title: Actively Exploited Oracle WebLogic Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Access Critical Data
news.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-21962, a CVSS 10.0 vulnerability in Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle WebLogic Server, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active exploitation. The flaw allows unauthenticated attackers with HTTP network access to access critical data, directly impacting authentication and access control in enterprise environments running Oracle middleware.

news.title: AWS Lambda functions now support full IAM resource-based policies
news.summary: AWS Lambda functions now support full IAM resource-based policies, expanding access control capabilities for platform admins and security teams. This update enables granular permission definitions using the complete feature set of AWS IAM for Lambda function access management.

news.title: Hackers target WordPress sites in miniOrange auth bypass attacks
news.summary: Hackers are actively exploiting two critical authentication bypass vulnerabilities in the miniOrange SAML 2.0 Single Sign On plugin for WordPress. The flaws allow attackers to forge SAML responses and gain administrator-level access to affected WordPress sites.

news.title: Microsoft Entra August 2026: Windows SSO control, Exchange attribute writeback, Lifecycle Workflows, and Cloud Sync
news.summary: Microsoft published its August 2026 Microsoft Entra feature roundup, announcing general availability of Windows SSO prompt control, Exchange Online attribute writeback via Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync, and Lifecycle Workflows testing updates. The release covers multiple identity and access management capabilities across SSO, directory synchronization, and identity governance workflows.

news.title: Treasury launches task force to prepare financial sector for quantum cyber threats
news.summary: The U.S. Treasury has launched a public-private task force to prepare the financial sector for quantum computing cyber threats. The task force will focus on transitioning financial institutions to quantum-resistant cryptography and addressing risks from vendors and digital assets.

news.title: NIST Warns of Unique Security Risks in Multi-Cloud Environments
news.summary: NIST has identified 23 novel security challenges specific to multi-cloud environments in a new publication. The challenges include issues relevant to IAM such as identity federation, access control consistency, and authentication across cloud providers.

news.title: ShinyHunters and ReliaQuest trade blows over claimed breach
news.summary: ShinyHunters threat actors claimed to have breached ReliaQuest, with evidence showing access to an employee's identity dashboard. ReliaQuest disputed the extent of the breach, stating that access did not go beyond that initial identity dashboard view.

news.title: GSA begins quantum security efforts for digital and physical systems
news.summary: The General Services Administration is updating its identity and access management framework and expanding physical security testing to support a government-wide migration to post-quantum cryptography. The effort reflects broader federal initiatives to prepare digital and physical systems for quantum-resilient security standards.

news.title: Passwordless workload identity on OpenShift
news.summary: The article covers passwordless workload identity authentication on OpenShift, focusing on how machine-to-machine authentication (specifically database interactions) is evolving away from static secrets. It addresses workload identity concepts including how non-human identities authenticate without traditional credentials, relevant to IAM professionals managing machine identity and zero trust implementations.

news.title: Suspected Russian Hackers Abuse Google OAuth and WhatsApp Linking to Hijack Accounts
news.summary: Three suspected Russian cyber espionage groups (UNC6293, UNC7005, and UNC5976) have been observed abusing Google OAuth authentication flows and WhatsApp account linking to hijack accounts. The attacks target individuals in academia, aerospace and defense, government, and think tanks across Europe and the U.S.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian threat actor Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The case involved credential-based attacks exploiting accounts without MFA, resulting in data theft from major companies including AT&T.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA published a postmortem after a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection processes relevant to IAM and PAM practices.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two members of the Scattered Spider cybercrime group pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to the August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and phishing to bypass MFA and compromise accounts.
